notes: The supplied text (catalog pp. 272-274) prints only the 'LACCD General Education (GE) Pattern – GE Pattern for Associate Degrees', a different award/pattern from the Cal-GETC Certificate of Achievement requested. The Cal-GETC pattern section itself does not appear in the text, so no blocks, total or outcomes were recorded; the source page link likely points just before the Cal-GETC section and a reviewer should check the following pages.
The LACCD pattern's 'Minimum of 27 semester units' was not recorded as this award's total because it belongs to the associate-degree GE pattern, not the Cal-GETC certificate.

The closed list includes Cal-GETC lab courses (ANTHRO 111, ASTRON 5, EARTH 2, GEOG 15, GEOLOGY 6, GEOLOGY 7, OCEANO 10, PHYS SC 14) and ECON C2001/C2002, none of which appear in this text, consistent with the text being the wrong section.
No program learning outcomes or careers are printed in the text.
